cases.evidence: A measured service rate moved from 98.2% to 98.3% across two periods.
cases.context: No confidence interval or expected variation was supplied.
cases.expected_judgment: Describe the observed difference without dramatizing it; stability or uncertainty may be more useful than a chart.

cases.evidence: One workload fell from 240 ms to 110 ms while four other measured workloads stayed within 2% of baseline.
cases.context: The same measurement method and workload population were used.
cases.expected_judgment: Give the material change more visual weight and keep stable workloads subordinate.

cases.evidence: Three of twenty groups account for 78% of the observed improvement.
cases.context: Group totals reconcile to the reported overall delta.
cases.expected_judgment: Surface the concentration instead of presenting all groups as equivalent.

cases.evidence: A completion metric is 73% for the latest month.
cases.context: No target, historical range, denominator, or comparison period is available.
cases.expected_judgment: Report the value as observed and leave performance classification unknown.

cases.evidence: Two proposed slides repeat the same baseline-to-current spend comparison with different labels.
cases.context: The decision audience and source evidence are identical.
cases.expected_judgment: Merge or remove the duplicate argument rather than preserving one slide per topic.

cases.evidence: A single category has one observed value and no meaningful comparison.
cases.context: The proposed bar has one bar and no target or distribution.
cases.expected_judgment: Use a direct statement or number unless the chart reveals a useful relationship.

cases.evidence: A time series has one sharp, source-verified outage on Tuesday.
cases.context: The outage timestamp is already labeled on the chart.
cases.expected_judgment: Place its supported implication near the event rather than adding a generic highlights panel.

cases.evidence: A pilot reduced verified cost by 85.6%; other metrics are unchanged.
cases.context: The executive asks whether to expand the pilot.
cases.expected_judgment: Allow the decision and dominant finding to occupy the page with supporting evidence and breathing room.

cases.evidence: Identical circles remain unchanged while a decorative square moves among them.
cases.context: No ordering, dependency, or state change is explained.
cases.expected_judgment: Remove the motion or replace it with a static relationship that carries evidence.

cases.evidence: A request is checked, rejected when invalid, otherwise executed and verified.
cases.context: The reject path returns to correction before execution.
cases.expected_judgment: Use a storyboard or diagram that reveals the gate and return path, not a falsely linear sequence.

cases.evidence: A failed validation sends work back for correction before the next attempt.
cases.context: Retries stop after two attempts and unresolved failures escalate to an operator.
cases.expected_judgment: Represent the bounded feedback and escalation so the audience sees what changes after failure.
